cases.title: Oxygen-fed photochemical oxidation
cases.protocol: A 0.20 M acetonitrile solution of substrate and 1 mol% photocatalyst is irradiated at 450 nm under 2.0 equivalents of oxygen at 40 C for 2 h in batch. Convert this to flow and report oxygen flow at inlet/STP and pressure-corrected in-channel conditions separately.

cases.title: Hydrogenation over a packed bed
cases.protocol: A 0.10 M ethanol solution of an alkene is hydrogenated over 5 wt% Pd/C at 50 C and 10 bar hydrogen for 4 h in batch. Design a continuous packed-bed process with gas-liquid mixing, catalyst retention, pressure control, and startup/shutdown safeguards.

cases.title: Ozonolysis with immediate reductive quench
cases.protocol: A 0.05 M solution of an alkene in dichloromethane is treated with ozone at -20 C until consumption, followed immediately by dimethyl sulfide quench. Propose a continuous process that minimizes ozone and ozonide inventory.

cases.title: Chlorine addition with inline quench
cases.protocol: An alkene solution at 0.20 M is exposed to 1.05 equivalents of chlorine gas at 0 C for 30 min in batch, then quenched with aqueous sodium thiosulfate. Translate to flow with explicit gas dosing and off-gas handling.

cases.title: Carbon monoxide carbonylation
cases.protocol: An aryl halide at 0.10 M is carbonylated using palladium catalyst, base, and carbon monoxide at 15 bar and 100 C for 3 h in batch. Design a continuous gas-liquid process with explicit CO containment and monitoring.

cases.title: Fast exothermic neutralization
cases.protocol: A 1.0 M organic acid stream and a 1.0 M sodium hydroxide stream are mixed at equal molar flow. Batch calorimetry indicates an adiabatic temperature rise of 55 C and completion in less than 2 s. Design a temperature-controlled continuous process.

cases.title: Salt-forming coupling with precipitation risk
cases.protocol: An aryl halide and amine are coupled in the presence of inorganic base in a 0.50 M solvent system at 100 C for 8 h. Substantial inorganic salt precipitation is observed during batch operation. Design a robust continuous process.

cases.title: Two-stage sequence with incompatible feeds
cases.protocol: Stage 1 oxidizes an alcohol with an organic peroxide at 40 C for 20 min. The resulting aldehyde must then be mixed with an amine, but direct contact of the amine with the peroxide feed is prohibited. Stage 2 proceeds at 80 C for 45 min. Design a continuous sequence with explicit delayed addition and residence time for each stage.
